name: learning-anything
description: Bun web server backend for Claude Code dynamic workflows. Serves knowledge graph data with LLM-powered agent capabilities via DeepSeek models.

scripts.build: mkdir -p _tmpout && bun build src/index.ts --outdir _tmpout --target bun --minify --sourcemap=external && cp _tmpout/index.js ../../dist/learning-anything-server.js && cp _tmpout/index.js.map ../../dist/learning-anything-server.js.map && rm -rf _tmpout
